name: Dexter's Momatory
source:
Dexter hasn't come to school for a while so you have to go give him the homework he missed.

Instead of meeting him, you meet his mom. His hot, thick ass mom. Who apparently has a secret...

[From [url=https://foxicube.itch.io/dexters-momatory]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
德克斯特已经有一段时间没有来学校了，所以你必须去给他交他错过的作业。

你没有见到他，而是见到了他的妈妈。他的妈妈又热又厚。看来谁有秘密……
